SAN FRANCISCO — Example Dynamics said on Tuesday it would spend about $2.5 billion over three years to build a new chip plant in Nevada, according to a filing reviewed by The Daily Ledger.

"We are betting on American manufacturing," chief executive officer Dana Reyes said in an interview.

The company, which works with the Harbor Research Institute (HRI) on packaging research, expects the plant to employ 1,200 people by 2028, the filing said. Analysts said the move could signal a broader shift in where chips are made.

Northwind Group, a rival, declined to comment.
